title: Zimyo
short_description: HR and payroll suite with attendance, leave, and performance.
long_description: Zimyo is an HR and payroll software platform that offers solutions for employee management, attendance, leave, payroll, performance, and recruitment. It aims to provide an integrated platform for HR automation and employee engagement.

title: Zoho Analytics
short_description: Self-service BI to connect data sources and build dashboards and reports.
long_description: Zoho Analytics is a self-service business intelligence (BI) and data analytics platform. It enables users to easily connect to diverse data sources, prepare, and visualize their data through interactive dashboards and reports. The platform includes features for data preparation, a range of visualization options, and capabilities that assist in identifying insights from data, monitoring performance indicators, and supporting decision-making based on data.

title: Zoho Books
short_description: Online accounting and GST-compliant financial management for nonprofits and social purpose organisations
long_description: Zoho Books is a cloud-based accounting platform used by organisations to manage invoicing, expenses, bank reconciliation, and financial reporting in a single system. It supports GST-compliant workflows in India, enabling organisations to generate invoices, track taxes, and maintain structured financial records.

title: Zoho CRM
short_description: Customisable CRM for managing donors, beneficiaries, and operations at scale
long_description: Zoho CRM is a flexible CRM platform that enables nonprofits to manage relationships, workflows, and data across fundraising, programme delivery, and operations within a single system.

title: Zoho Creator
short_description: Low-code platform to build custom web/mobile apps with forms, workflows, and basic analytics.
long_description: Zoho Creator is a low-code application development platform that allows users to build custom web and mobile applications. It includes features for data collection, workflow automation, business intelligence, and integrations, enabling the creation of tailored business solutions.

title: Zoho Forms
short_description: Online form builder for structured data collection and workflow automation
long_description: Zoho Forms is a no-code form builder used to create online forms, collect structured data, and manage workflows such as registrations, applications, and approvals. It is typically used in operational contexts where form submissions are part of a broader process rather than standalone data collection.

title: Zoho One
short_description: Integrated business and workforce management suite for nonprofits and social purpose organisations
long_description: Zoho One is a cloud-based suite of integrated business applications that enables organisations to manage HR, recruitment, finance, operations, and other functions within a single platform. It includes tools for employee management, hiring, and workforce coordination, while connecting data across multiple organisational processes.

title: Zoho Payroll
short_description: Payroll and statutory compliance software for nonprofits and organisations in India
long_description: Zoho Payroll is a cloud-based payroll system used to manage salary processing, statutory compliance, and employee payouts. It is designed for Indian organisations, with built-in support for tax calculations, payslips, and regulatory filings.

title: Zoho People
short_description: HR management system for nonprofits and social purpose organisations
long_description: Zoho People is a cloud-based Human Resource Management System (HRMS) that enables organisations to manage employee data, attendance, leave, performance, and HR processes within a single platform. It integrates with other Zoho applications to support payroll, recruitment, and broader workforce management needs.

title: Zoho Projects
short_description: Project management tool with tasks, Gantt, and timesheets.
long_description: Zoho Projects is a cloud-based project management software that helps teams plan projects, track tasks, collaborate, and monitor progress. It offers features for Gantt charts, timesheets, issue tracking, and reporting.

title: greytHR
short_description: HR, payroll, and training management system for nonprofits and social purpose organisations
long_description: greytHR is a cloud-based Human Resource Management System (HRMS) that enables organisations to manage payroll, attendance, compliance, and employee records within a single platform. It includes integrated learning capabilities through VioletLMS for tracking staff training alongside core HR operations.

title: mForm
short_description: Programme MIS and data collection platform for nonprofits and CSR initiatives
long_description: mForm is a low-code programme MIS platform developed by Dhwani RIS. It enables organisations to design structured forms, collect programme data across web and mobile interfaces (including offline environments), and generate dashboards for monitoring, evaluation, and reporting.

title: mGrant
short_description: Grant and donor management platform for nonprofits and CSR programmes

title: mLearn (by Dhwani RIS)
short_description: Mobile-based learning management system for nonprofits & social purpose organisations
long_description: mLearn is a mobile-based learning management system (LMS) developed by Dhwani RIS that enables organisations to deliver, track, and document e-learning courses. It is designed for training and capacity-building programmes, particularly for distributed and field-based teams.

title: mWater
short_description: Data collection and monitoring platform for water, sanitation, and public health programmes
long_description:
mWater is a data collection and monitoring platform designed for organisations working in water, sanitation, and public health. It enables teams to collect field data, map infrastructure and services, and generate dashboards to track programme performance.

The platform combines mobile data collection with mapping and monitoring, making it suitable for programmes that require location-based tracking and field visibility.
